dataset: Adobe Express ChatGPT integration test personas
creative_task: Use ChatGPT with Adobe Express to create an eagle-themed design with a yellow background.

personas.name: Aarav Mehta
personas.ai_trust_level: Curious but needs confirmation before applying changes
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids uploading personal photos or university-only assets

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Beginner skill level requires ChatGPT to turn simple instructions into a guided Adobe Express workflow.
A student can start from an existing layout instead of building a design from scratch.
Supports simple edits to place or refine an eagle image without complex manual masking.

acceptance_criteria: Design includes a clear eagle image
Background is visibly yellow
Instructions are simple enough for a beginner
No personal student information is used
personas.chatgpt_prompt: I am a beginner marketing student using Adobe Express with ChatGPT. Please guide me one step at a time to create an eagle-themed poster with a bright yellow background. Use Conversational Design Creation to help me pick a simple template, then use Templates and Generative Fill to add or improve the eagle image. Keep the language simple, tell me where to click, and ask me to confirm before making any major change. Do not use personal photos or university-only assets.

personas.name: Maya Rodriguez
personas.prompt_style: Creative brief with visual adjectives and platform requirements
personas.ai_trust_level: High trust for ideation, reviews final output manually
personas.privacy_posture: Comfortable using licensed stock assets, avoids client-confidential material
avoid_list: Client names or unreleased campaign details

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Supports fast creative exploration for a stylized eagle visual.
Needed to adapt the final design for social posts and stories.
Provides decorative elements that match social media trends.

acceptance_criteria: Square and story-ready versions are considered
Eagle image feels modern and social-media friendly
Yellow background remains dominant
No confidential client material appears
personas.chatgpt_prompt: Act as my Adobe Express creative partner for a social campaign concept. I need a bold, scroll-stopping eagle graphic on a saturated yellow background. Use Text to Image for a modern eagle style, add Design Assets that feel energetic but not corporate, and remind me to use Resize for a square feed post and a vertical story. Keep the copy short and visual. Avoid client names, unreleased campaign details, and anything that could look low resolution.

personas.name: Lena Schmidt
personas.ai_trust_level: Moderate trust with strict review checkpoints
personas.privacy_posture: Requires enterprise-approved assets and brand governance

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Ensures fonts, colors, and templates stay within approved brand rules.
Allows the yellow background and eagle design to be checked against approved brand assets.
Matches the persona's strict privacy posture for enterprise workflows.

acceptance_criteria: Uses only approved brand kit elements
Yellow background complies with brand guidance
Eagle asset source is reviewable
Design includes a final compliance checkpoint
personas.chatgpt_prompt: Support me in Adobe Express as an enterprise brand manager. Create an eagle-themed design with a yellow background only if the color, typography, and layout can stay inside Enterprise Brand Control rules. Use Brand Kits to select approved fonts, colors, and templates, and apply Security & Compliance checks before suggesting export. Give me a structured workflow with review checkpoints for asset source, contrast, readability, and brand approval. Do not introduce off-brand fonts, external logos, or unsupported claims.

personas.name: Noah Thompson
personas.prompt_style: Goal-focused, practical, asks for business-ready output
personas.ai_trust_level: Moderate trust when benefits are explained
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sharing customer data or private sales figures

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Supports a time-constrained user who needs fast background and image adjustments.
Provides ready-made business layouts for posters or flyers.
Helps place an eagle cleanly on a yellow background.

acceptance_criteria: Workflow has minimal steps
Design is suitable for a business promotion
No customer data is included
Text remains easy to read
personas.chatgpt_prompt: Help me make a business-ready Adobe Express flyer with an eagle on a yellow background. I want the quickest reliable path: choose a clean Template, use Background Remover if the eagle image has a messy background, and use Quick Actions for any fast resizing or cleanup. Keep the steps minimal and explain why each step matters. Do not include customer names, sales figures, or overly experimental design ideas.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.privacy_posture: Does not include employee names, faces, or internal HR issues

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Training lead needs slide-ready output for employee learning.
Accessibility needs require readable text, contrast, and alt text validation.
Supports review by HR or training stakeholders before publishing.

acceptance_criteria: Slide design includes an eagle and yellow background
Accessibility checklist is included
No employee personal information appears
Design is appropriate for workplace training
personas.chatgpt_prompt: Guide me through creating an inclusive Adobe Express training slide with an eagle image and a yellow background. Use Presentation Templates for a clean learning layout, Accessibility Checks for contrast, readable text, and alt text, and Collaboration so another HR reviewer can approve it. Give me a checklist format and use calm instructional language. Do not include employee names, faces, HR cases, or insensitive eagle metaphors.

personas.name: Jamal Carter
personas.prompt_style: Mission-led, narrative, asks for ethical asset use
personas.ai_trust_level: Selective trust after source and rights checks
personas.privacy_posture: Protects donor, volunteer, and beneficiary identities

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Helps select rights-cleared eagle imagery for public nonprofit communications.
Useful for planning nonprofit campaign publishing once the design is complete.
Supports plain language and screen-reader-friendly content.

acceptance_criteria: Eagle asset has clear usage rights
Yellow background supports readable text
No donor or beneficiary identity is exposed
Message remains ethical and mission-led
personas.chatgpt_prompt: Help me create a responsible Adobe Express nonprofit campaign graphic featuring an eagle against a yellow background. Use Adobe Stock Integration so the eagle image is rights-cleared, then use Accessibility Checks for readable text and screen-reader-friendly wording. Include a reminder that Content Scheduler can be used after approval. Keep the message warm and mission-led, and avoid donor names, beneficiary images without consent, manipulative language, or unlicensed imagery.

personas.name: Elena Petrova
personas.ai_trust_level: Low trust unless decisions are traceable
personas.privacy_posture: Requires confidential information controls and auditability

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Legal operations requires controlled handling of assets and AI-assisted changes.
Traceability is needed because the persona has low trust in untracked AI decisions.
Ensures the eagle design remains approved for organizational use.

acceptance_criteria: Every AI-assisted change is reviewable
No confidential legal matter details are used
Design follows approved enterprise controls

personas.chatgpt_prompt: Assist me with a controlled Adobe Express workflow for an eagle design on a yellow background. Use Security & Compliance guidance first, then Enterprise Brand Control for approved colors and layout, and Version History to keep AI-assisted changes traceable. Provide formal numbered steps and include an export approval checklist. Do not use confidential matter details, legal advice wording, untracked AI edits, or vague approval language.

personas.ai_trust_level: Low trust until the result is visible
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sharing personal address, phone number, or community member photos
avoid_list: Photos of community members without permission

adobe_express_feature_mapping.reason: Novice user needs slow, visible, one-action-at-a-time support.
A simple flyer template reduces complexity and visual clutter.
Large text and contrast requirements need explicit validation.

acceptance_criteria: Instructions are delivered one step at a time
Text is large and easy to read

personas.chatgpt_prompt: Please help me slowly create a simple Adobe Express community flyer with an eagle picture and a yellow background. Use Guided Editing and Templates so I can follow one action at a time, and use Accessibility Checks to make sure the text is large, clear, and easy to read. Ask me to confirm after each step before moving on. Do not include my address, phone number, or photos of community members without permission.

personas.chatgpt_prompt: Help me prepare an educational Adobe Express design with an eagle image on a yellow background for a museum learning activity. Use Adobe Stock Integration for approved eagle imagery, Multilingual Content Support for Japanese and English text planning, and Text Effects only where they improve readable captions. Please include notes on which statements need factual review. Avoid restricted collection images, unpublished research, unverified historical claims, and crowded layouts.

personas.chatgpt_prompt: Please give me a careful, printable checklist for making an Adobe Express newsletter graphic with an eagle image and a yellow background. Use Guided Editing so I can approve each change myself, Accessibility Checks for large print and high contrast, and Print-ready Export when the design is finished. Use traditional, respectful wording. Do not use slang, tiny decorative text, member contact details, private club stories, or automatic publishing.
